title: Candles Modpack for Hypixel Skyblock
description: client-side modpack made around Hypixel Skyblock
body:
🕯️Candles Modpack is a **client-side** modpack for Hypixel Skyblock version 1.21.5.  
It aims to be convienient, aswell as bring the best balance of optimization, utility.  

 • Skyblocker • Skyhanni • Skyocean • Sodium • More Culling •  

🕯️Candles Modpack features popularly used mods, aswell as less known but very useful mods to enhance gameplay and allow full customizability.  

 • Clearviews • Scale Me • Firmament • REI •  

This modpack will be updated semi-frequently to fix bugs and add new mods

**Before downloading remember, "all use of modifications on our server is at your own risk"**

https://support.hypixel.net/hc/en-us/articles/6472550754962-Hypixel-Allowed-Modifications
